children: Emkay Global Financial' research report on GAIL

GAIL’s transmission volumes, hence, should improve qoq and, for FY27, may exceed the guidance of 123mmscmd. Additionally, while gas marketing profitability would decline qoq as formulaic trailing averages normalize, the guidance of Rs40-45bn for FY27 should still see a sizable beat given stable Henry Hub settlement prices as well as oil and spot LNG rates continuing to remain elevated. We build in Brent at $85/bbl, though the 1HFY27 average is likely to be ~$100/bbl; hence there is a potential upside to our estimates. The petchem segment, as a result, should report a better EBITDA qoq, with plant utilization expected at near-100% capacity. We slightly raise FY27-29E EPS by 2-3% each, updating the FY26 annual report data, and rollover to Sep-28E earnings. GAIL Gas’s IPO RFP has already been released and a potential listing next year can lead to value unlocking of its wide CGD interest. We conservatively value unlisted investments at 1x PBV.

We upgrade GAIL to BUY from Add, on the back of a steady core business and earnings outlook along with attractive valuations, with unchanged TP of Rs200. Indian gas demand, despite the Strait of Hormuz crisis and higher LNG prices, has improved sequentially in 2Q, with Jul/Aug-26 recording only a 2% decline yoy.
